irene: Quick doc microtask: add a tiny runtime-fallback example to the v1->v2 migration page. Needs one short para, a 2-line TS + Py fallback snippet that only triggers on 5xx/network, a one-line curl smoke test, and a support ticket template. Keep it minimal. Who can own?

oz: I can. Plan: keep examples tiny and explicit not to swallow auth errors; add a telemetry comment.

oz: TS snippet:
```ts
const c = new (require('@redwood/inference').Client)()
try { await c.generate({model:'redwood-v2', input:'hi'}) } catch (e){ if (e.status >= 500) /* emit metric */ await c.generate({model:'redwood-v1', input:'hi'}) else throw e }
```

oz: Py snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
try:
    c.generate(model='redwood-v2', input='hi')
except Exception as e:
    if getattr(e, 'status', 0) >= 500:
        # send metric
        c.generate(model='redwood-v1', input='hi')
    else:
        raise
```

oz: Curl smoke test (one-liner):
`curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"ping"}' || curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"ping"}'`

sam: Docs CI: lint ok. Suggest adding support template: "Observed availability fallback from redwood-v2 to redwood-v1 for request <id> at <ts>. Attach sample prompt/output and whether embeddings were used."

support-bot: Posted alert config to #support: notify if fallback rate >5/hour.

irene: Thanks. Oz please open the PR with the para + snippets + curl + support template and a changelog bullet. I'll review and merge if green.
